howto: Tap bubbles to pop them before they float off the top.
Bigger bubbles score more; ⭐ bubbles split in two, gold bubbles add 4 seconds.
Never tap a 💣: it ends the round at once.
tips: Pop quickly one after another to build a combo: every 4 pops raises the multiplier.
Gold bubbles buy time: +4 seconds each.
Bombs never appear in the first 8 seconds or the last 7.
Bubbles rise faster as the round goes on.
A ⭐ bubble needs two taps: the first splits it.

controls.keyboard: Space or Enter on Play; the round is played with the mouse. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: An adaptive curve inside each round: bubbles come more often and rise faster, and bombs become more likely as time runs down.

cheats.effect: No bombs: only bubbles float up
Slow bubbles: everything rises at 60% speed
Big bubbles: every bubble is a big one

features.one-tap-start: Play starts the 45-second round at once
features.instant-restart: Play Again on the results card starts a new round
features.best-score-badge: 🏆 best in the top bar next to the score
features.tutorial-card: First-round card with a tapping finger that stays until your first pop
features.results: Time's Up or Boomed card with score, best, run stats, rank, lifetime pops and badges
